senses.gloss:
ITA-9.2.109 paścāt-karma पश्चात्-कर्म
Posttherapy procedures
The variety of procedures which are advised after a major therapeutic procedure in order to return a person to normalcy.

ITA-6.2.7.5 aścādpbhaktaḥ, adhobhaktaḥ, bhojanottaram पश्चाद्भक्तः, अधोभक्तः, भोजनोत्तरम्
Administration of medicine after a meal

ITA-2.8.27 pāśavakāyaḥ पाशवकायः
Person with cowardly, unintelligent temperament
The characteristics of the person with a cowardly, unintelligent temperament are dullness, lack of grasping power, slowness and laziness, daily dreams of intercourse and indecisiveness.

ITA-5.62.10 pāṣāṇagardabhaḥ पाषाणगर्दभः
Temporomandibular joint region inflammation
A disorder characterized by a swelling with pain in the lower jaw joint; firm swelling in the lower jaw joint.
